# pvecli ct

Manage containers (LXC).

| Command | What it does |
|:--|:--|
| [`start`](start.md) | Start one or more containers. |
| [`stop`](stop.md) | Stop one or more containers (hard stop). |
| [`shutdown`](shutdown.md) | Shutdown one or more containers gracefully. |
| [`reboot`](reboot.md) | Reboot one or more containers. |
| [`add`](add.md) | Create a new container interactively or with options. |
| [`deploy`](deploy.md) | Create a ready-to-use container in one command. |
| [`clone`](clone.md) | Clone a container. |
| [`migrate`](migrate.md) | Migrate a container to another node of the cluster. |
| [`edit`](edit.md) | Interactively edit container configuration. |
| [`remove`](remove.md) | Delete one or more containers. |
| [`tag`](tag.md) | Manage container tags. |
| [`snapshot`](snapshot.md) | Manage container snapshots. |
| [`template`](template.md) | Convert one or more containers to templates. |
| [`image`](image.md) | Manage LXC image files. |
| [`ha`](ha.md) | Manage container HA resources. |
| [`vnc`](vnc.md) | Open authenticated VNC console(s) for one or more containers. |
| [`ssh`](ssh.md) | SSH into a container (IP resolved via interfaces API). |
| [`list`](list.md) | List all containers. |
| [`info`](info.md) | Show detailed information about a container. |
